verdict.rationale: Resend is an API-first email product. Its first-party API reference covers the core operations: sending single and batch emails, broadcasts, domains, webhooks, suppressions, API keys and received emails. A probe confirmed a live public OpenAPI spec at /openapi.json, and community users praise the breadth and idiomatic quality of its SDKs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Start sending emails through the Resend Email API.
Send batch email (up to 100 messages per request) via `POST https://api.resend.com/emails/batch`.
You can add and verify a domain you own in four ways: in the Domains Dashboard page, using the Resend API, with a Resend CLI command, or with the Resend MCP server
Create a webhook to receive real-time notifications about email events.
PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://resend.com/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
I have to say I'm impressed at the breadth of their SDK support (even Elixir) and how idiomatic they seem in each language
